post.summary: createStaffLogin
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Provisions a brand-new, EMAIL-LESS staff login (external account + platform identity + provider binding + active membership + initial role+scope assignment) in one step — the onboarding path for POS floor staff who have no email. The provider subject is minted by the server and never accepted from the client. The assigned role must be a subset of the caller's own tenant-wide permissions (anti-escalation). Exact replay returns the original response; changed intent conflicts.

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. Resolves an existing account by EXACT email (case-insensitive, trimmed) so a manager can add it as staff — this is a confirmation lookup, NOT a browsable directory: there is no display-name, partial, substring, or wildcard search, and no pagination. Returns already-provisioned, active identities that do not yet hold a membership in this tenant, with a minimal projection; never reveals other tenants' membership relationships. An unknown email, an inactive identity, and an already-a-member identity are indistinguishable (all return an empty list). Because primary_email is not unique, the response is an explicit 0..N list ordered by identity id ascending (bounded to 50 exact matches): 0 items = no eligible account; 1 item = an unambiguous account; more than 1 = multiple provisioned identities share the exact email, and the client MUST require explicit selection and MUST NOT silently choose one (the server never collapses or prefers a match). Does not create identities or send invitations.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Exact email of the existing account to link (trimmed, case-insensitive).

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. The canonical catalog of EXISTING roles in the caller's own tenant that may be selected for a Role+Scope assignment — use it instead of deriving options from assignments other staff already hold. Read-only: it creates, edits and deletes nothing, and role/permission authoring remains out of scope. Archived roles are excluded (assignment rejects them). Anti-delegation: a role appears only when every active permission it carries is already held by the caller tenant-wide — the same subset rule the assignment write enforces. The filter is a convenience, NOT the authorization boundary: POST /role-assignments re-runs the check independently, so knowing a role id grants nothing and no role name is ever interpreted. Ordered by role name ascending.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. The canonical catalog of EXISTING active access scopes in the caller's own tenant that may be selected for a Role+Scope assignment. Read-only: scope and scope-target authoring remains out of scope. Scopes are NOT filtered against the caller because a scope carries no authority of its own — it only narrows where an assigned role's permissions apply, and the role is already subset-filtered. Explicit scopes project their existing targets (brand / branch / warehouse / inventory_location) with the display name read from the referenced record; no label is invented and every target is tenant-bound by composite foreign key. Tenant-mode scopes have no targets. Ordered by scope name ascending.

parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

put.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Sets or rotates the staff member's OFFLINE-unlock PIN — a credential independent of their Clerk online password — used by the POS offline cashier when the device has no connection. The PIN is sealed server-side (AES-256-GCM) and never stored or returned in plaintext; the offline bootstrap later emits a device-bound scrypt verifier derived from it. Anti-escalation: the target's held permissions must be a subset of the caller's own tenant-wide permissions. Returns 503 when the server has no offline-PIN key configured.

delete.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Revokes an active assignment (history-preserving; never deleted). Cannot strand the tenant's last active staff.manage membership.

After 8 misses for one order number within 15 minutes, lookups for that number answer 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS. Shows first name and city only, never the street address or email.

requestBody.description: Tenant, optional brand, order number and phone.

post.summary: Ask to return delivered items from an online order.
post.description: Public, unauthenticated; identified like tracking (order number + checkout phone). Opens a request for staff and moves no stock or money. Quantities are capped by what was delivered, minus returns and open requests. 422 RETURNS_DISABLED / ORDER_CANCELLED / RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED / NOT_YET_DELIVERED / NOTHING_TO_RETURN; 409 RETURN_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED.

requestBody.description: The order, lines with quantities and reasons, refund or exchange, optional note.

get.description: Newest first. status defaults to open (requested + approved). Requires returns.read. awaitingDecision counts every request still waiting for a first decision.

post.summary: Approve, decline or complete a customer return request.
post.description: Requires returns.create on the order brand and Idempotency-Key. requested -> approved | declined; approved -> completed | declined. Repeating the current status is a no-op.

requestBody.description: The new status and an optional staff note.

get.description: Newest first, with the tenant's total. Requires orders.read.

get.summary: List published collections for a storefront tenant.
get.description: Public, unauthenticated. Returns only active collections that own at least one publicly visible product, each with a cover image and product count.

get.summary: Read a single published collection by slug with its products.
get.description: Public, unauthenticated. Returns the active collection for the given tenant and slug with its ordered, publicly visible products, or 404 if missing or not public.

get.summary: List inventory balances in the caller's inventory read scope.

parameters.name: inventoryLocationId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant inventory location.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.summary: Read the Website/POS stock split of an inventory location.
get.description: Returns the location's channel stock mode and, unless it is legacy, the website / pos / unallocated buckets per variant with derived reserved and available quantities. Requires inventory.read over the location.

post.summary: Set up Website/POS stock channels for an inventory location.
post.description: Moves the location from legacy to shadow mode and places all existing stock in the unallocated bucket (no split is guessed). Customer-facing stock is unchanged. Calling it again is a no-op that returns initialized=false. Requires inventory.adjust over the location and an Idempotency-Key header.

200.description: The location's channel mode after the call.

post.summary: Split stock between Website and POS at an inventory location.
post.description: Sets absolute Website and POS quantities per variant; unallocated is the remainder. The split cannot exceed on-hand, cannot leave Website below open website reservations, and cannot leave POS below reserved POS stock (422). An optional expectedBalanceVersion per line makes a split built from stale numbers a 409. Locations that are still legacy are a 409. Requires inventory.adjust over the location and an Idempotency-Key header; an exact replay returns the same run and a same-key/different-body request is a 409.

200.description: The allocation run and the post-commit buckets of every variant in the split.

post.summary: Receive stock into an inventory location.
post.description: Records received stock at a single in-tenant inventory location. Requires the inventory.receive permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header; a replay with the same key and body is not applied twice, and the same key with a different body is a 409.

200.description: The recorded receipt and observed post-commit balance.

post.summary: Reconcile an inventory count to a physically observed on-hand.
post.description: Reconciles the balance at a single in-tenant inventory location to a counted on-hand, guarded by the version it was counted against (optimistic concurrency). Requires the inventory.adjust permission over the target location and a required Idempotency-Key header. A stale expectedVersion is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The authoritative before/after balance for the reconciliation.

post.summary: Transfer stock between two inventory locations.
post.description: Atomically moves stock from a source to a destination inventory location. Requires the inventory.transfer permission over BOTH the source and the destination location and a required Idempotency-Key header. Insufficient source stock is a 409; a same-key/different-body replay is a 409.

200.description: The recorded transfer and observed post-commit balances of both sides.

get.summary: List orders in the caller's orders read scope.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant brand.

parameters.name: branchId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single in-tenant branch.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.summary: Read a single order's detail and fulfillment progress.

200.description: The order detail with embedded fulfillment progress.

post.summary: Fulfil lines of an online order from its reserved stock location.
post.description: Online orders only. Requires orders.fulfill on the order brand and inventory.issue on the reserved location, plus Idempotency-Key. The server resolves the location from the order reservations. Exact replay returns the original fulfillment; changed intent conflicts.

post.summary: Cancel an unfulfilled online order and release its stock reservations.
post.description: Online orders only. Requires orders.cancel on the order brand and Idempotency-Key. Refused (409) once any fulfillment exists; cancelling an already-cancelled order replays.

get.summary: List active registers the caller is fully authorized to sell from.

200.description: The caller's server-derived register selling contexts.

get.summary: Read on-hand stock for a register the caller is authorized to sell from.
Read the post-sync conflict report of emergency offline POS operation.
get.description: ADR-042 §13.5. Read-only report of business conflicts the server detected while syncing offline commands (shared-stock shortfall after a Website sale, voucher, possible duplicate customer, stale debt/excess paydown, attendance, rejected dependency, integrity). It is not an approval queue and never changes the original record. With registerId the caller needs that register's POS permissions; without it tenant-wide orders.read. No customer name or phone is included.

parameters.name: registerId
parameters.description: Restrict to one register (POS till view).

200.description: Conflicts, newest first, with open/informational counts.

post.summary: Atomically complete a cash POS sale.
post.description: Creates one canonical POS Order, captured cash Payment, full Fulfillment, and inventory issue in one transaction. Currency, branch, and location are derived from the Register. A stale expectedTotalMinor returns PRICE_CHANGED before mutation. One Idempotency-Key protects the complete sale intent.

requestBody.description: Register, expected total, received cash, and variant quantities.

200.description: The completed atomic sale and its canonical components.

post.summary: Enroll and activate an offline-capable POS device.
post.description: An authorized human binds a locally generated Ed25519 public key and installation to one tenant register. Private keys are never accepted.

post.summary: Rotate an active POS device public key.

requestBody.description: Replacement public key and register authorization context.

post.summary: Revoke a POS device and its current credential.

requestBody.description: Revocation reason and register authorization context.

post.summary: Issue a bounded immutable offline grant and complete catalog snapshot.
post.description: Requires a normal authorized human session. No policy means offline selling is disabled. At most one device may hold active authority per inventory location.

200.description: The grant and exact price snapshot.

post.summary: Ingest a new customer captured offline (name + phone).
post.description: Device-authenticated (ADR-042 §8). The phone must be E.164. The till's localCustomerId becomes the customer id. When another customer already has the phone, duplicateOfCustomerId is set; records are never merged. Idempotency-Key must equal command.syncCommandId; an exact replay returns the original result.

post.summary: Record a terminal hold for an offline sale whose new customer was rejected.
post.description: Device-authenticated (ADR-042 §4.6). Carries the original signed sale and a signed hold naming its SHA-256 fingerprint. The server verifies both signatures, the grant binding and window, that the ordinal is unused and that the customer the sale depends on does not exist, then records the ordinal as held_for_reconciliation: no order, payment, debt or customer link is created, the sale is not voided, and its units stay reserved so the stock grant can close. Idempotency-Key must equal command.syncCommandId; an exact replay returns the original receipt; a different hold or sale for the same ordinal is refused (409).

requestBody.description: Signed hold plus the original signed sale.

put.summary: Set or change your own POS override password.
put.description: ADR-042 D-6. Only accounts holding promotions.manage or payments.refund. The caller re-enters their POS username and PIN (same lockout as sign-in). At least 10 characters, must not contain the username or PIN, and not a common password (422). Sealed server-side; never returned.

post.summary: Enrol your own offline PIN on one POS device (no PIN is sent).
post.description: Offline PIN v2. The authenticated caller enrols themselves on an active device assigned to the register; requires the register's seller permissions. The request carries no PIN: the till derives and seals the device-bound verifier in its main process. Supersedes the caller's previous enrollment on that device (new verifierVersion). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Revoke offline PIN enrollments.
post.description: Your own with seller access; anyone's or a whole device's with tenant-wide staff.manage. Effective at the device's next online bootstrap and at the latest when its current lease ends.

delete.summary: Clear a staff member's POS override password.
delete.description: Requires tenant-wide staff.manage and Idempotency-Key. The password is never read or set by an admin.

get.summary: Per-channel limits and POS offline terms of a voucher.
get.description: Requires a tenant-wide promotions.read grant.

put.summary: Set a voucher's limit and (POS only) offline terms for one channel.
put.description: ADR-042 §5. Website and POS counters are independent. Offline is offered only with a finite usage limit, a per-grant quota and both owner discount caps (D-7). Narrowing offline authority bumps the policy version so outstanding till grants become exceptions. A limit below redeemed + reserved is a 409.

put.summary: Set a code's own usage limit for one channel.

get.summary: Offline voucher discounts honoured without a valid reservation.
get.description: ADR-042 D-2 report. The sale stood at the price paid; no task or approval is created. Requires promotions.read.

post.summary: Ingest a cash sale already accepted offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent and historical grant prices. It returns synced when stock can be issued, otherwise persists the order/payment and a governed reconciliation. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

post.summary: Ingest a customer installment paydown already accepted offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent and the grant binding, then applies the paydown idempotently against the customer's outstanding balance. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

requestBody.description: Signed immutable offline customer payment command.

post.summary: Ingest an attendance clock event already captured offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent, the grant binding, and acceptedAt/eventAt skew, then appends an immutable, provisional clock event idempotently keyed to syncCommandId. The event is received as pending-policy; it is never payroll-final and never mutates attendance entries. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

post.summary: Ingest an operation intent captured offline and dispose of it automatically.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent, the grant binding and acceptedAt window, the register's opt-in list of offline intent operations, and dependency ordering, then, in the same transaction, automatically disposes of it: a typed server handler applies the authorized effect under the register's handler policy (applied), or the command is rejected, marked needs_reconciliation (conflict with canonical state; no side effect) or blocked_policy (no approved handler policy; fails closed). There is no human approval step and no pending state. The immutable command and its disposition are appended idempotently keyed to syncCommandId; an exact replay returns the original disposition and never repeats an effect. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

post.summary: Issue a bounded per-order offline return grant.
post.description: Requires a normal authorized human session. Freezes server-authoritative return eligibility (per-line eligible quantities and the net-basis refund ceiling) into an immutable, device/register-bound, short-window grant so the till can offer only pre-authorized return lines/amounts while offline. Refusing a non-returnable order.

requestBody.description: Enrolled device, register, and the original order.

200.description: The bounded return grant and frozen eligibility.

post.summary: Ingest a merchandise return already accepted offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent and the return grant binding, asserts each line is within the grant's frozen eligibility, then recomputes the NET refund server-side and records a canonical Return with a PENDING (withheld) refund — settlement never occurs offline and canonical stock is never posted at ingestion. Eligibility drift or a revoked device yields needs_reconciliation. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

200.description: Canonical return ingestion result with withheld refund.

clerkSessionToken.description: Clerk session token presented as a Bearer credential.

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: The tenant the request operates within.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for the write. A replay with the same key and body is not applied twice; the same key with a different body is rejected with a 409.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with current state.

Error413.description: The export exceeds the maximum row count.

Error429.description: Too many attempts; try again later.
